plugins.name: quoxpert
plugins.description: Quox as a Claude-extension: 39 sub-skills that make any Claude an expert at operating Quox. Covers the quox CLI (every command group), QuoxMCP's 130+ RBAC-gated tools, QuoxBastion/QuoxAgent fleet ops, workflows and QLoop, governance and evidence (AEE/AOCL/VOLT/WARD, WARD chains, HITL approvals), QuoxSecurity engagements, QuoxVault, ContactsQ/NotesQ and the social channels, the plugin SDK, converting tools into plugins, publishing, RepoBrain code intelligence, and deploy.
